title: US plumbing code clearances (IPC and IRC)
edition: IPC §405.3.1 (2015 text as adopted by Ohio; the 2018 edition's change notes); IRC R307.1 (2015, as adopted by Seattle; NC OSFM interpretation)
notes: The UPC (California Plumbing Code 402.5) asks for 24 in in front of a WC, lavatory or bidet and 12 in from a urinal centreline; copy this pack to use it.

zones.description: 15 in (381 mm) from the centreline of a WC, urinal, lavatory or bidet to any side wall, partition, vanity or other fixture; 30 in between centrelines
21 in (533 mm) clear in front of a WC, urinal, lavatory or bidet to any wall, fixture or door
24 in (610 mm) clear in front of a shower opening
